turns.replyText:
The first time, set it up in the room where you want it, since the connected pad is difficult to move:

Clear the floor completely.
Lay out the cushioned pad pieces according to the numbered layout for your rug size.
Connect the interlocking edges and gently press them until they sit flush.
Place the rug cover over the pad and tuck each pad corner into the matching patented corner pocket underneath the cover.
Center the cover and smooth out wrinkles from the middle outward.
Pull the cover gently taut and apply the included corner grippers before placing furniture on it.

For cleaning, remove the cover from the pad first. The removable cover is machine-washable; the cushioned pad isn’t. You can find the visual steps here: https://www.tumbleliving.com/pages/assembly 🙂
